headline: Waist-to-chest SSE with offshore N all day — the neighbor spot worth a peek.
today: Good SSE angle and offshore N winds the whole day make this a clean little session, arguably better shaped than most days this week. Period's short so it's more of a fun-size crumble than anything with drive. Log or fish, work the mid-tide windows around the 8:38a low or the afternoon push. Not worth a special trip beyond Rockaway, but if you're already out here it's the call.

daysToWatch.note: Prime SSE angle but short period and cross-on SW all day — soft and textured. Skippable unless you're desperate.
